stable.notes: Miles Windu's four active-session stories now use the reviewed V15 artwork rendered from 2x masters. One session deflects an off-screen bolt, closes the distance, reveals the droid and cuts it down. Two sessions restore the approved single-strike and backswing-deflection fight. Three sessions carry the rebuilt thirteen-frame three-droid sequence with one attached purple saber in the final recovery. Four or more sessions keep the full sixteen-frame swarm escalation. Every strip keeps one authored scale through the loop, transparent RGBA, cleared frame gutters and an exact opening composition at the seam. Existing byte-identical stock Miles V7 installs advance automatically; custom sprites, OpenPets characters and the three other bundled Jedi are unchanged. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
